# Depikt

> Depikt is a visual creation workflow for discovering prompts and references, building or improving image prompts, and generating or editing images. Explore proven prompt examples, build and improve image prompts in one Prompt workspace with Build and Critique modes, browse visual references, generate or edit images directly, and learn from practical prompting guides.

Depikt's Library currently includes **543 curated prompts**: 500 original GPT Image 2 examples and 43 tested ChatGPT Images 2.5 recipes.

Build and Critique are two modes of one workspace at https://depikt.app/prompt (not separate products). Generate, at https://depikt.app/generate, creates and edits images from a prompt and optional references. The older URL https://depikt.app/critique redirects to the matching Prompt mode.

## Core tools

- [Library](https://depikt.app/library): Browse 543 curated image prompts across posters, infographics, UI concepts, social graphics, cinematic scenes, product imagery, illustrations, image edits, multi-panel layouts, reference workflows, and more. Each entry includes a sample image, the full prompt, and an explanation of why it works. The Library contains both GPT Image 2 and tested ChatGPT Images 2.5 examples in one collection.

- [Prompt](https://depikt.app/prompt): One workspace for writing and reviewing image prompts. It has two modes; they are not separate products.
  - [Prompt workspace — Build mode](https://depikt.app/prompt?mode=build): Describe what you want to create and optionally attach a reference image. Depikt analyzes the requested format, composition, exact text, aspect ratio, reference intent, missing information, and other constraints before producing a structured image prompt. Reference workflows include style, subject identity, edit source, product/object, composition, and sketch/layout.
  - [Prompt workspace — Critique mode](https://depikt.app/prompt?mode=critique): Review an existing image prompt, optionally with its reference or source image. Depikt evaluates intent fidelity, clarity, contradictions, composition, reference handling, edit preservation, text and layout, style coherence, factual integrity, and efficiency, then suggests concrete improvements and a rewritten prompt.

- [Generate](https://depikt.app/generate): Create images from a prompt and optional reference images, then edit results, regenerate, and keep every version. Depikt resolves the requested format/aspect ratio automatically and routes generation between GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Sunburst internally — there is no model, quality, or size selector for the user to configure.

- [Reference Gallery](https://depikt.app/gallery): Visual-first discovery. Browse hand-picked visual references across different styles and formats, then send one straight into the Prompt workspace in Build mode as a reference, or generate with it directly.

- [Templates](https://depikt.app/templates): Reusable, model-neutral structures for common image tasks (subject, composition, text, references, lighting, style, constraints, preserve/change, format). Choose a task, fill in the structure, and finish it in the Prompt workspace (Build mode).

- [Blog / Field Notes](https://depikt.app/blog): Depikt's knowledge layer: Images 2.5 guides, historical GPT Image 2 guides, prompt and editing techniques, comparisons, experiments, and product announcements.

- [MCP for AI assistants](https://depikt.app/integrations/mcp): Public, read-only access to the same prompts, templates, and guides for MCP-compatible assistants (endpoint https://depikt.app/mcp). See "Use Depikt through MCP" below.

## ChatGPT Images 2.5

OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.5 on September 8, 2026. Depikt's Prompt workspace (Build and Critique modes) has been updated around the newer model's stronger reference handling, precise edits, structured visuals, text-heavy layouts, and multi-turn workflows.

The Library contains **43 generated and reviewed ChatGPT Images 2.5 recipes** alongside the original GPT Image 2 collection.

### Images 2.5 guides

- [ChatGPT Images 2.5: What's New and What It Means for Prompting](https://depikt.app/blog/chatgpt-images-2-5-whats-new): A practical look at the Images 2.5 release, including reference fidelity, precise editing, multi-turn consistency, Sketch, Templates, shared prompts, and the API models.

- [How to Prompt ChatGPT Images 2.5](https://depikt.app/blog/how-to-prompt-chatgpt-images-2-5): A structured approach to intent, subject, composition, aspect ratio, exact text, style, references, and constraints.

- [Precise Edits and Reference Images in ChatGPT Images 2.5](https://depikt.app/blog/chatgpt-images-2-5-precise-edits-reference-images): How to describe targeted changes, preserve important details, assign reference roles, use sketches as layout guides, and reduce drift during editing.

- [Posters, Infographics, and Slides with ChatGPT Images 2.5](https://depikt.app/blog/chatgpt-images-2-5-posters-infographics-slides): Techniques for exact text, hierarchy, structured layouts, diagrams, infographics, and presentation-ready visuals.

- [ChatGPT Images 2.5 Prompt Examples: 12 Recipes](https://depikt.app/blog/chatgpt-images-2-5-prompt-examples): Complete examples across posters, product imagery, infographics, UI concepts, edits, reference images, and other common workflows.

## Use Depikt through MCP

Depikt is available through a **public, read-only MCP integration** for compatible AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude.

Assistants can use Depikt to:

- search approved prompts in the Library
- open an individual prompt in full
- list available prompt templates
- open an individual template in full
- search published Depikt guides by topic or category
- read a guide in full

The MCP integration exposes only information that is already publicly available on depikt.app. It does not provide access to private user information, unpublished content, account data, or write actions, and it does not include image generation — MCP stays read-only even though the depikt.app web product itself can generate and edit images.

This allows workflows such as:

- "Search Depikt for a vintage travel-poster prompt."
- "Find three prompt examples for product photography."
- "Open the full prompt for this reference style."
- "What templates does Depikt have for infographics?"
- "Read Depikt's guide to precise image editing and explain the recommended structure."

## Prompt templates

[Browse all prompt templates](https://depikt.app/templates).

The 15 active templates are grouped into Create, Structure, Edit, References, and Brand, and all live on the single [Templates](https://depikt.app/templates) page. Each template opens in the prompt workspace with its structure prefilled.

## About

Depikt is built for designers, marketers, founders, developers, and anyone who wants a better starting point for image creation.

The Library and Gallery help with discovery and inspiration. Templates provide reusable structures. The Prompt workspace turns an idea into a stronger prompt (Build) or identifies what is missing or weakening an existing one (Critique). Generate then creates and edits the image itself, without leaving Depikt.
